text: The human infrastructure follow-up adds priority: high to tb-rust-vendor. The adjacent project-selection list, worker type and runtime limit stay unchanged in the owned diff. Accepted local transforms do not rewrite priority in the inspected scope. This configuration change does not prove shorter queue time, successful scheduler enforcement or a faster vendor run; those require separate generated-task and execution evidence.
title: The Rust vendor task priority change leaves its trigger and worker configuration separate
